surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Won the 2023 Stab in the Dark with Italo Ferreira. Reduced rocker over the CI Pro makes it accessible to a wider range of intermediates while still rewarding expert technique.

models.raw_performance_description: Meet the winning surfboard for the 2023 Stab in the Dark with Italo Ferreira, the CI 2.Pro! This model features the same outline and bottom contours as the 2022 winner but with reduced overall rocker. The design offers added speed via the reduced rocker, making it easier to surf for a wider range of surfers in a greater variety of waves.
display_description: Competition-proven shortboard with reduced rocker for added speed across a wide range of conditions.
Subtle single-to-double concave gives drive and control without sacrificing maneuverability.
A step more forgiving than the CI Pro — without giving up performance.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: More user-friendly version of the Happy. Fuller rails and a wider tail block reward surfers who are building confidence in their surfing. Good daily driver for intermediates.

models.raw_performance_description: Created by Britt Merrick, through work with Dane Reynolds and Parker Coffin, the Two Happy takes all the high-performance speed and flow of the original Happy but makes it more accessible and user-friendly for a broader range of surfers and conditions.
display_description: A more accessible version of the Happy — same speed and flow, friendlier feel.
Fuller rails and wider tail block make it easier to paddle and accelerate.
Ideal daily driver for intermediate surfers in everyday surf.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Designed with Mike Andrews and Patrick Gudauskas. A slightly more parallel outline and forgiving rocker gives it a wider sweet spot than a pure competition board.

models.raw_performance_description: The Fever has its roots in Al Merrick's trusted and proven high-performance shortboard designs. The board aims to deliver speed and zest for creativity through a slightly more parallel outline and forgiving rocker with an accessible sweet spot suitable for varied conditions.
display_description: Performance shortboard rooted in Al Merrick's proven designs.
Flattened nose and tail rocker delivers speed; hip squash tail adds pivot.
Wider sweet spot makes it accessible for intermediates chasing performance.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Dane Reynolds collaboration with angular, skatey character. The round block tail and single concave reward surfers who want to explore creative lines rather than pure performance surfing.

models.raw_performance_description: When something isn't broke, there's no need to fix it. That said, Britt Merrick and Dane Reynolds still felt a few slight refinements would make an already epic board that much better. The NeckBeard 3 features single concave throughout, enhancing wave entry, speed, and control. The tail block was widened by half an inch with a slight hip for responsiveness.
display_description: Dane Reynolds collaboration with a distinctive angular character and skatey feel.
Single concave throughout improves entry and speed over previous versions.
Widened round block tail gives smoother transitions while keeping the loose, playful vibe.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: 2025 evolution of the Happy Everyday. Five fin boxes with quad as stock setup. The relaxed hip and swallow tail give a loose, skatey feel suited to weak everyday surf.

models.raw_performance_description: For 2025, we introduce the Better Everyday! The trademark hip is relaxed, allowing the board to be smoother off the bottom. Increased flip out the tail loosens up the board out of the top of the lip while the decreased hip is a more positive feeling off the bottom. The board includes five fin boxes and comes stock as a quad setup.
display_description: 2025 evolution of the Happy Everyday — smoother bottom turns, looser off the top.
Five fin boxes with quad as stock; swallow tail adds bite in weak surf.
Wide size range suits everyone from beginners to advanced surfers chasing fun in small waves.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Ride 1 inch shorter than your Happy Everyday. Wider nose and tail with more rocker than the original DD gives it a different character — more volume up front for paddle power while the subtle concave keeps it lively.

models.raw_performance_description: The DD2 has a wider nose and tail, more nose and tail rocker, and a more subtle single concave. The design evolved from riding the original during Out of the Rafters filming, modernizing it for improved performance across varied conditions. Recommended sizing: ride 1 inch shorter than your Happy Everyday.
display_description: Updated fish-groveler with wider nose and tail and more rocker than the original.
Subtle single concave keeps speed and response in weak, gutless surf.
Ride it 1 inch shorter than your everyday board for the right feel.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Gudauskas brothers collaboration. Ride 3–6 inches shorter than your CI Pro at the same thickness. The 2+1 setup gives the free feel of a twin with added control from the trailer.

models.raw_performance_description: The G Skate is built to inspire you with the signature Gudauskas brother energy — Pure stoke. This collaboration creates a fast, skatey and responsive swallow-tailed hybrid design. The board features shortened rail lines, a light single-to-double concave bottom, low entry rocker, and forward wide point.
display_description: Gudauskas brothers hybrid — fast, skatey, and built for pure stoke.
Shortened rail lines and forward wide point create a loose, playful feel.
2+1 setup blends twin fin freedom with thruster control.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Combines the proven Happy rocker with tuning for larger, more powerful surf. A genuine do-it-all travel and adventure board that handles from overhead to well overhead.

models.raw_performance_description: If you are looking for a good wave board, bigger wave board, or a do it all exploration and adventure board the Happy Traveler is it! This step-up design combines the proven rocker of the Happy model with tuning for larger, more powerful surf. The board features decreased concave between fins, a straighter pulled outline in the back third, and optimized fin placement for enhanced hold and control in quality waves.
display_description: Step-up built on the Happy's rocker but tuned for larger, more powerful surf.
Straighter pulled outline and optimized fin placement deliver hold and control.
Works as thruster or quad — a genuine do-it-all travel and exploration board.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Ride 2–4 inches longer than your standard 2.Pro. Maintains the 2.Pro's responsive feel while adding the length and stability needed for waves of consequence.

models.raw_performance_description: Lengthened and refined, the all new Pro Step Up has become the go to performance board in waves of consequence. The board maintains curves from the popular CI 2.Pro shortboard but is extended for larger, steeper conditions. Channel Islands recommends riding this step-up 2-4 inches longer than your standard 2.Pro to maintain responsive feel while gaining stability in serious waves.
display_description: Performance step-up built on the CI 2.Pro's curves for waves of consequence.
Ride 2–4 inches longer than your 2.Pro for stability without losing response.
Intended for advanced to expert surfers pushing into serious overhead surf.

surfer_fit_profile.fit_notes: Devon Howard collaboration. Low entry rocker and foam forward for effortless paddle and trim. The 2+1 fin setup suits cruisy to performance-oriented riding. Works well for surfers wanting a change from shortboards.

models.raw_performance_description: The CI Mid is a modern classic design resulting from a fun collaboration with Devon Howard. The board features low entry rocker and foam a tad forward for ease of paddle and effortless trim speed with double-barrel concave, gradually accelerated rocker, and hard, slightly tucked rails. It excels in shoulder-high to nearly double overhead point surf.
display_description: Devon Howard collaboration — a modern classic midlength built for effortless trim and glide.
Low entry rocker and double-barrel concave deliver sustained speed on the face.
2+1 fin setup with True Ames fins suits shoulder-high to double-overhead point surf.
